newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Kern County, Calif. $40 mln TRANs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Kern County, Calif. $40 mln TRANs.

text.p: Board of Education of the County of Kern
The Board of Education of the County of Kern (the Board''), intends to sell and receive sealed or telecopied bids for $40,000,000* of its 1997-98 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes at:

or thereafter as established by the Board, and communicated through Munifacts News Service, not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received, at the offices of Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., the Financial Advisor to the Board (the Financial Advisor''), by telecopy at (415) 896- 0210, or in person or by mail at One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, Attention: Jon White. Further information may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at (415) 281-8504. IF NO LEGAL OR ACCEPTABLE BID IS RECEIVED ON THE DATE SPECIFIED ABOVE, BIDS WILL BE ACCEPTED AT THE SAME PLACE AND TIME ON A LATER DATE TO BE ESTABLISHED BY THE BOARD AND COMMUNICATED THROUGH MUNIFACTS NEWS SERVICE NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME BIDS ARE TO BE RECEIVED. THERE IS NO GUARANTY THAT THE FINANCIAL ADVISOR'S
TELECOPIER WILL BE AVAILABLE TO RECEIVE BIDS PRIOR TO OR AT 10:30 A.M. PACIFIC DAYLIGHT TIME ON THE DATES LISTED ABOVE. TELECOPIED BIDS ARE AT THE RISK OF SUCH BIDDER.
